steps.title: Items and states
steps.body: world.give("coin", 1) puts items in the hero's inventory (the HUD lists them). world.setState(instance, "open") changes a placed asset's state — the chest opens its lid.
steps.task: Give a coin and open the chest in the chest block.

steps.title: Teleport and spawn
steps.body: world.teleport(spawn) moves the hero to a spawn point; world.travel(map, spawn) goes to another map; world.spawn(asset, spawn) puts a new copy of an asset there (world.despawn removes one).
steps.task: When rich: teleport home and spawn a chest.

steps.title: Everyone in a zone
steps.body: forEachInZone(zone, (who) => { … }) runs its inside once for each thing standing in the zone; who is that thing.
steps.task: Log who is in the pond zone.
